interface.title: One screen, and the depth opens over it
body: The page never becomes a long scroll of sections. Studio and Skill are tabs: each wipes a dark sheet down over the page, the same tab closes it, the other tab swaps it, and Escape closes it.
What stays on the page is the promise, one prompt to copy, and the agents it works with.

palette.title: Apple's greys, with colour saved for two moments
palette.body: Near-black on white, and greys for everything else. A holographic gradient marks the open tab and the announcement chip, and a yellow floods the hero when you point at the main button.

type.title: A grotesque with character for the big lines
type.body: Bricolage Grotesque sets the headline and the sheets' big lines, Inter does the reading, and IBM Plex Mono labels and code.

faces.sample: Same link. Feels like an app.
A skill and a studio that teach your coding agent.

features.title: One prompt to start, four parts after it

items.name: Setup prompt
items.text: One button copies a prompt. Pasted into any coding agent, it installs the skill and opens the studio.

items.name: Studio
items.text: Your running app in a desktop window and several phones side by side, each phone with its own user agent, touch and safe areas.

items.name: Skill
items.text: Six steps for the agent, each with a checkpoint: shell, navigation, layout, input, installable, shareable.

items.name: On my phone
items.text: A temporary HTTPS link and a QR code, to open the app on a real iPhone or Android.
